rows.comments: The source confirms all three elements of the claim: (1) Clive Uhr was the grandson of Wentworth D'Arcy Uhr, (2) he was a radiologist, and (3) he was knighted in 1972. Since he already held a C.B.E. (Commander of the Order of the British Empire) and was subsequently knighted, this straightforwardly implies elevation to Knight Commander (K.B.E.), which is the standard progression within the Order.
rows.source_quote: Clive's grandfather was Wentworth D'Arcy Uhr. ... Sir Clive Wentworth Uhr (1903-1974), radiologist and racing administrator ... He was appointed C.B.E. in 1961 and knighted in 1972.

rows.comments: The source supports that multiple alt-right groups are experiencing decline (Spencer suspending tour, his lawyer quitting, Identity Evropa losing members, TWP co-founder leaving). It also connects the fraying to Charlottesville and 'public scrutiny.' However, the source explicitly hedges on the cause ('not yet clear exactly why'), and 'harsh light of public scrutiny' is not quite the same as 'widespread public backlash against neo-Nazism and white supremacy.' The claim presents the attribution as more definitive than the source does.
rows.source_quote: "What we are seeing is a sort of falling apart, or a fraying, of the movement, which really began with Charlottesville, where the so-called Unite the Right rally put them under the harsh light of public scrutiny," he said. Lenz said it was not yet clear exactly why the movement appeared to be in turmoil.

However, the source says 'is a member' (singular, referring to Abernethy only), while the claim says 'are ordained members' (plural, referring to both Abernethy and his wife). The word 'ordained' does not appear in the source, and the source does not state that his wife is also a member.
rows.source_quote: He lives in Washington, D.C. and Jaffrey, New Hampshire, and is a member of the United Church of Christ.

Steve Bruce's failure to beat Fulham in the Championship play-off final was always likely to have severe ramifications.

rows.comments: The source confirms all key elements of the claim: the military (ZDF) spokesman Maj Gen SB Moyo said on state television early Wednesday (the next day) that Mugabe was 'safe and sound,' insisted it was not a coup, said the situation would return to normal once the armed forces were done, and that they were targeting 'criminals around' Mugabe who were 'committing crimes that are causing social and economic suffering.'
rows.source_quote: Insisting it was not a coup, Moyo said "as soon as [the armed forces] are done the situation will come to normalcy".

rows.comments: The source portrays the Beauforts as the primary allies and supporters of Henry VI during the Wars of the Roses. Edmund Beaufort is described as the king's 'right-hand' and 'infallible in the eyes of the man who mattered: Henry VI,' while later Beaufort dukes fought to reclaim the crown for their 'Lancastrian kin.' The source frames the entire conflict as a York v Beaufort rivalry, implying the Beauforts were the chief Lancastrian protagonists. A minor complication is Henry Beaufort's temporary defection to the Yorkist side, but the overall characterization of the Beauforts as chief Lancastrian supporters is well supported.
rows.source_quote: Somerset's reputation collapsed amongst some of the nobility in England, particularly York, although he was infallible in the eyes of the man who mattered: Henry VI.

rows.comments: The source is a 2017 Popular Mechanics article titled "The 10 Most Fun 'Star Trek: The Next Generation' Episodes," which includes "Starship Mine" in its list. The article describes Picard crawling around his ship to save it and calls it "a race against ... the clock," matching the claim.
rows.source_quote: In "Starship Mine," Jean-Luc acts out a kind of Air Force One in space, the lone commander crawling around his ship to save it from bad guys. ... It's a race against intergalactic terrorists and against the clock.

rows.comments: The source confirms Upton co-sponsored a bill in 2019, but the bill is described as mandating background checks for private firearm sales, not banning sales between private individuals. Upton himself states the bill 'doesn't take away the legitimate rights of folks who want to own firearms.' The bill regulates private transfers by requiring background checks; it does not ban them.
rows.source_quote: A new bill that aims to mandate background checks for nearly all commercial and private firearm purchases has bipartisan support within Michigan's congressional delegation.

rows.comments: The AP investigation found that the coalition reduced AQAP presence through deals (paying militants to leave) and recruitment rather than military force, with conquests coming 'without firing a shot.' The source also confirms the 'exceptional fighters' rationale for recruitment.

That's because the coalition cut secret deals with al-Qaida fighters, paying some to leave key cities and towns and letting others retreat with weapons, equipment and wads of looted cash ... Hundreds more were recruited to join the coalition itself. ... rows.comments: The source confirms Hilton died at age 75 and suffered from dementia. The article is dated 2019 (copyright and January 2019 funeral dates), confirming the year of death.

rows.comments: The source confirms that the five ads were each timed to run just after the corresponding song was sung in the show, and that Dan Lovinger (described as exec veep of entertainment ad sales, reasonably paraphrased as 'advertising chief') said NBC wanted the ads to 'enhance the excitement' for families. The source does note NBC was unsure whether the ads would run immediately at the start of a commercial break or later within it, but this does not contradict the claim's broader statement about timing relative to the songs.
rows.source_quote: Indeed, Walmart will air five thirty-second ads in all, each timed to run just after the song being featured in each spot has been sung in the show. ... NBC hopes the show will bring families together and "kind of wanted this to enhance the excitement," said Dan Lovinger, exec veep of entertainment ad sales at NBCU.

rows.comments: The source confirms Jimenez served as auxiliary bishop of Butuan and titular bishop of Arba from 11 June 2003. However, the claim states both roles lasted 'until his death.' The source shows his auxiliary bishop role ended on 2009.05.07, while his titular bishop role ended on 2018.04.19 (his death date). So the titular bishop part is fully supported, but the auxiliary bishop part is contradicted — it ended in 2009, not at his death in 2018.
rows.source_quote: Auxiliary Bishop of Butuan (Philippines) (2003.06.11 – 2009.05.07) Titular Bishop of Arba (2003.06.11 – 2018.04.19)

The source does not describe the centre as busy, nor does it state that the centre works exclusively with this group.

rows.comments: The Order of Battle lists the 32nd Training Sqn under the 1st Air Wing, which falls under Air Training Command headquartered at Hamamatsu, Shizuoka. Unlike other air wings in the same section that have separate base locations listed (e.g., 4th Air Wing at Matsushima, Miyagi), no separate base is given for the 1st Air Wing, implying it is at the command HQ location. This is corroborated by the 'Air Wing Formation Dates/Current Base Locations' section, which lists the 1st Air Wing's current base as Hamamatsu, and by a photo caption referencing '32nd Sqn aircraft' in the context of the 1st Air Wing.
rows.source_quote: ## AIR TRAINING COMMAND (HQ: Hamamatsu, Shizuoka) 1st Air Wing 31st Training Sqn 32nd Training Sqn

rows.comments: The source confirms the film was available in the U.S. and Canada in May 2018 and that November 1 was a relevant date for Crunchyroll streaming. However, the claim says the film was 'streamed' in May, when the source specifies it was 'screened' in theaters. The claim also says Crunchyroll 'streamed it starting in November,' but the source states streaming began in September for premium members, with November 1 being when it became available to free users.
